description: Fill a template's slots and get back a finished PNG. Text shrinks to fit its box. Image slots take an https PNG, JPG or GIF URL under 4 MB. Leave a slot out to keep its sample. Costs 1 credit.

modifications.description: Keyed by slot name. A value is a string, or an object like {"text": "...", "color": "#fff"} or {"image_url": "https://..."}.
